gumtree_entries.description: DELETED o3: Should never throw. Should return a String, not null.
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link Options}, the registry that collects {@link Option} and {@link OptionGroup} instances for a command line.
ADDED i4: Builds a bare {@link Option} that carries only the given short name.
ADDED i5: Builds an {@link OptionGroup} containing one bare option per supplied short name.
ADDED i6: Asserts that both string renderings of an option are non-null and never throw.
ADDED i7: 'b' is shared between a group of options1 and a group of options2, and 'x' is shared between a single option and a group, so merging must fail.
ADDED i8: Note: these two are intentionally added to options1, matching the original test.
ADDED i9: The merged groups are exactly the two source groups (order independent).
ADDED i10: The merged options are exactly the union of both sources: a, b, x, y, e, f, c, d.
ADDED i11: Adding into an empty Options must reproduce the source exactly.
ADDED i12: Adding an Options to itself duplicates every key, which is rejected.
ADDED i15: helpOptions() and the full set must contain exactly the same options.
ADDED i16: Parsing with no arguments must report the single missing required option.
ADDED i17: Parsing with no arguments must report both missing required options.
ADDED i18: While standalone, the required option is tracked in the required list.
ADDED i19: Once the option joins a group, the group (not the option) carries the requirement.
